exercises.question: Which form is the future subjunctive?

exercises.sentence: Los socios abonarán la cuota antes del día diez.
exercises.english: Members are to pay the fee before the tenth.

exercises.sentence: Los socios ____ de cumplir el reglamento.
exercises.english: Members are to comply with the regulation.

exercises.sentence: Todo socio que ____ la cuota a tiempo mantendrá su parcela.
exercises.english: Any member who pays the fee on time will keep his plot.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: En caso que haya dudas, la junta decidirá.
En caso de que hay dudas, la junta decidirá.
En caso de que haya dudas, la junta decidirá.

prompt.speaker: Carlos
prompt.text: En el reglamento antiguo pone «quien no abonare la cuota».

options: Quiere decir «quien no abonó la cuota».
Quiere decir «quien no abone la cuota».
Quiere decir «quien no abonaría la cuota».

exercises.english: Non-payment of the fee will be grounds for expulsion.

exercises.sentence: Si el socio no cumpliere el plazo, perderá la parcela.
options: If the member had not met the deadline, he would have lost the plot.
Because the member did not meet the deadline, he lost the plot.
If the member does not meet the deadline, he will lose the plot.

template.prompt: Give the modern equivalent of «el que infringiere la norma», with the present subjunctive.
Using «habrán de», say that the members must respect the regulation (use «reglamento»).
template.answer: Los socios habrán de respetar el reglamento.

template.prompt: Using «el incumplimiento» and «será motivo de», say that failing to comply with the regulation will be grounds for a warning.
template.answer: El incumplimiento del reglamento será motivo de amonestación.

template.prompt: Using «salvo que» and the subjunctive of «avisar», say that the contract is renewed unless one party gives notice.
template.answer: El contrato se prorrogará salvo que alguna de las partes avise.

exercises.english: Members who wish to hand over their plot must notify it in writing.
